notes: gold_chunk_ids reference the 7 seeded Qdrant document ids in seeds/demo_data.py DOCUMENTS. Only 3 of them (doc-door-sensor, doc-motor-overheat, doc-brake-inspection) are also ontology Document nodes (DOCUMENTED_BY from O21); the other 4 have no Document node, so their gold_node_ids name the Asset/Component instead.
Unanswerable cases have empty gold_chunk_ids and are EXCLUDED from the recall/nDCG/MRR means; the harness reports them separately (count + how many candidates the retriever returned).
sibling_confusion cases are lexically near-identical problems on different assets (O21 vs O22); Phase 1's exit criterion measures this subset specifically.
